response.sql: SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) as attendance_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as proportion FROM attendance a INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status

assumptions.assumption: Only event statuses with at least one attendance entry are included in the result; statuses with zero attendance are excluded

alternatives.interpretation: Include all distinct event statuses from the event table, even those with zero attendance entries, calculating their proportion as 0 relative to the total
alternatives.sql: SELECT e.status, COUNT(a.link_to_member) as attendance_count, COUNT(a.link_to_member) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(a.link_to_member)) OVER () as proportion FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status
